short.en: Print asset labels with QR code or barcode on label printers (Zebra and similar)

long.en: Adds the "Print labels" massive action to the asset lists of GLPI. Select only the assets you want, review the texts and get a PDF laid out for label rolls with one or more labels per row. Label templates define the label size, columns, margins, printer resolution, QR code or Code 128 barcode (asset link, inventory number, serial number or name), an uploaded logo converted to pure black and white, and the text lines (inventory number, description, user, location, entity...). Includes a calibration PDF to align the print with the die-cut of the roll.
